Collection.description:
A grouping the source holds itself, such as an epic or a milestone (0.10). Each task names the collections it
belongs to in `Task.collections`.

path.description:
The file the source keeps the collection in, relative to the line as `Task.path` is, when it has one. An epic
of the plan is `epic.md`; a milestone of a tracker has none.

CollectionGroup.description: One ordered group of a collection, such as a slice of an epic: the keys of its tasks, in order.

CollectionMember.description: What one task is now in: the ids of its collections, as `list` gives them in `Task.collections`.

description: `collections.changed`: collections, or what a task is in, changed with no change to the task's file.

collections.description: Every collection of the checkout now, as `list` gives them. It replaces what core holds.

members.description: Each task whose collections differ from the last time the source said.

title: CollectionsChanged
